profile.headline: Full stack developer.
profile.summary:
I love all things tech and have been delving into a wide variety of topics in this field for over 20 years. 

My portfolio includes at least some sort of proficiency in the following technologies:

HTML5, CSS3 (SASS), JavaScript, PHP, Node.JS, Python, Bash; Linux Server/Desktop, Windows, macOS & iOS; Microsoft Office Suite and O365; Microsoft Active Directory; Adobe Creative Suite; Confluence, JIRA, Bitbucket, Git; Logic Monitor, SolarWinds, Zabbix, LogRythm; hardware/software troubleshooting.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I work on our flagship TMS application written in PHP. I also solely maintain and administer our smaller freight forwarding NodeJS and React app. I handle code deploys, server maintenance, and other various IT-related tasks and troubleshooting.

positions.title: Website Developer
positions.description: I have done website design for many years on and off, working with many of the different new technologies that have popped up over the years. I currently monitor and support just a handful of sites. I've found myself being more interested in other languages such as Python and have moved towards a focus on backend work, although I still enjoy web design and it is what I cut my teeth on in my early years.

positions.title: Enterprise Operations Center Technician
positions.description: As an Enterprise Operations Center Technician, I am responsible for the monitoring of cloud storage platforms, mobile device activation solutions, and our IoT platform for customers.  I monitor both production and nonproduction systems to proactively identify service impacting events including hardware, software, network, and facility issues to ensure the best service for our clients. I perform health checks on the various applications to ensure they are running and if there is an issue, work to resolve it in an expedited timeframe. I regularly develop and implement tools or scripts and updated procedures to maximize our efficiency and optimize the team’s performance.

positions.title: Service Desk Senior & SME
positions.description: In this leadership position, I acted as the subject matter expert for less experienced team members, coordinated with the LAN team (ITSM team) to provide in-depth troubleshooting, imaged and set up laptops, configured workstations, and managed the team’s Confluence space. To provide outstanding customer service and support for team members and management, I needed to communicate effectively and worked diligently to achieve goals and meet the needs of our customers. During this time, I also played an instrumental role in the establishment of an International Service Desk team based out of India.

positions.title: Service Desk Agent
positions.description: I developed and maintained a thorough knowledge base on Confluence for my team and other employees. I took customer calls and emails from colleagues, as well as customers, with issues or complaints to resolve. I was responsible for troubleshooting and delegating between teams to provide quick problem resolution. My meticulous work and dedication were recognized when I was awarded Employee of the Month for performance excellence and was promoted to a Senior Agent position.
